name: Admit One
source:
Ethan bides his time in a lounge, hoping his fiancé will find him. When a stranger arrives instead, reality blurs, and time proves to lack forgiveness.

[From [url=https://burlapjoe.itch.io/admit-one]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊森在休息室等待时机，希望他的未婚夫能找到他。当一个陌生人到来时，现实变得模糊，时间证明缺乏宽恕。

[来自[url=https://burlapjoe.itch.io/admit-one]Itch.io[/url]]
